title: Satwik-Chirag Conquer China Masters Ahead of Asian Games Defence
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant title, boosting confidence for their Asian Games gold-medal defence.
summary: The Indian men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, brilliantly came back to defeat their Chinese rivals and win the China Masters, setting a strong tone for the upcoming Asian Games.

title: Satwik-Chirag's China Masters Win Proves Fitness for Asian Games
indian_angle: This article highlights how the China Masters victory confirmed the physical readiness of India's star doubles pair for the demanding Asian Games.
summary: After five matches and four three-game contests, Satwik-Chirag's China Masters title proved their bodies could withstand a demanding week, providing crucial evidence of their fitness ahead of the Asian Games.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for international junior competitions, nurturing the next generation of players.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This change in scoring system for domestic junior tournaments will impact how young Indian players develop their game and strategy.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
